Estimates for the population and growth rates of these cities vary by source due to the complexities of urban demographic projections. Based on the available data, here is a comparison of the three cities:

| City | Estimated Population | Growth Trend |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cairo** | ~10.1M – 23.2M | Lowest growth rate (~1.07%) |
| **Lagos** | ~14.9M – 21.9M | High growth (~2.48% – 3.3%) |
| **Kinshasa** | ~16.9M – 21.85M | Highest growth rate (~5.13%) |

**Conclusion:** While sources differ on exact population figures, Kinshasa is consistently identified as having the highest annual growth rate among the three, significantly outpacing the more stabilized growth seen in Cairo. Lagos also exhibits rapid expansion, consistently growing faster than Cairo. 

Sources: World Population Review (Lagos, Kinshasa, Cairo 2026), Wikipedia (List of cities in Africa by population), and Tutor2u (GCSE Geography).
